description: Fix two post-merge defects: false remote-prune warning every ship (classify prune by end-state, not delete exit code) and the back-to-back send-keys narration race (coalesce post-merge-complete + prune sub-status into one line).

userStories.title: Classify remote prune by end-state in runPostMerge
userStories.description: As the post-merge primitive, I need to determine remote-branch prune success by branch existence (the desired end-state) instead of the delete command's exit code, so that the false 'remote: FAILED' warning emitted every ship (after GitHub auto-deletes the head branch on merge) disappears.
acceptanceCriteria: runPostMerge pre-checks the remote branch via `git ls-remote --heads origin <mergedBranch>`; when the output is empty the remote branch is already absent and branchPrunedRemote is set true without (or regardless of) the delete attempt. [oracle: bun test]

When `git ls-remote` reports the branch present, runPostMerge runs `git push origin --delete <mergedBranch>` and then re-derives branchPrunedRemote from the post-delete end-state (branch absent => true), never directly from the delete command's exit status. [oracle: bun test]

When `git ls-remote` itself errors (non-zero status: network/auth failure), runPostMerge falls back to attempting the delete and classifies on the delete exit code; it does NOT assume the branch is absent. [oracle: bun test]

After a ci-gated merge where GitHub already deleted the remote head branch, runPostMerge returns branchPrunedRemote:true (proven by a unit test simulating an empty ls-remote, or a delete that fails with 'remote ref does not exist' yet leaves the branch absent). [oracle: bun test]
All git interactions still go through the injectable SpawnFn (no direct child_process / git binary calls added). [oracle: grep -q 'spawnFn' src/release/post-merge.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Aggregate quality gate passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: File: src/release/post-merge.ts (Step 5 remote delete is lines 209-213; branchPrunedRemote derivation line 213). Add a `git ls-remote --heads origin <mergedBranch>` pre-check via the existing SpawnFn before the delete; empty stdout (status 0) => already pruned. GOTCHA from spec: ls-remote is a NETWORK call; if it returns non-zero (rede/auth), do NOT treat the branch as absent: fall through to attempting the delete and classify on the delete exit. Keep the function under the file-size/complexity limits (extract a helper if needed, mirroring readVersionTag/performTagStep). branchPrunedRemote must keep reflecting the real end-state so the logEvent('merge-watch-post-merge-done',...) detail in merge-watch.ts stays truthful. Re-check scripts/cam/patterns.md 'Merge-watch state machine pattern' bullet for the injectable-deps contract. This story leaves the local leg (-d) untouched (US-002). FAKES-LIE HAZARD (auditor F-02): test/release/post-merge.test.ts spawn fakes (happySpawn/makeSpawnFn, lines 32-80) do NOT model the new git ls-remote --heads origin <branch> call; they silently return the status-0 empty-stdout default (CAM-82 extend-fakes hazard), so the remote end-state classification could pass BY LUCK (empty stdout => already-pruned) without the fake genuinely modelling the command. This story OWNS extending those fakes to model git ls-remote --heads origin <mergedBranch> for BOTH cases (empty/absent => pruned, and present/non-empty => attempt delete then re-classify) so US-001 bun test/check:all is a real green, not a false green. Do not defer this to US-004.

userStories.title: Classify local prune by end-state and force-delete with `git branch -D`
userStories.description: As the post-merge primitive, I need to determine local-branch prune success by branch absence and to force-delete a squash-merged branch with `git branch -D`, so that a still-present squash-merged branch is pruned successfully and a never-existed branch is reported as pruned (end-state) rather than as a delete failure.
acceptanceCriteria: The local delete uses `git branch -D <mergedBranch>` (force), not `git branch -d`. [oracle: grep -q "'-D'" src/release/post-merge.ts]

branchPrunedLocal is derived from the local end-state via `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<mergedBranch>` (absent/empty => pruned true), not directly from the delete command's exit status. [oracle: bun test]
A local branch that is already absent before the delete yields branchPrunedLocal:true with no spurious failure. [oracle: bun test]
A local branch that is present is force-deleted (`git branch -D` invoked) and, when the post-delete rev-parse shows it absent, branchPrunedLocal is true. [oracle: bun test]
All git interactions still go through the injectable SpawnFn. [oracle: grep -q 'spawnFn' src/release/post-merge.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Aggregate quality gate passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: File: src/release/post-merge.ts (Step 4 local delete is lines 204-207; branchPrunedLocal derivation line 207). Switch `-d` to `-D` and re-derive branchPrunedLocal from a `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<mergedBranch>` end-state check (status non-zero / empty stdout => absent => pruned). GOTCHA from spec: `git branch -D` (force) is SAFE ONLY because post-merge runs from the confirmed MERGED state (processPollResult status.state === 'MERGED' in merge-watch.ts); preserve that invariant, do not call this primitive from any non-MERGED path. Empirically the local branch is often already absent at post-merge (pruned by the next cycle's /cam-plan pre-flight), so the force-delete matters mainly in the branch-present case. Check test/integration/post-merge-on-main.test.ts (it references the old `branch -d` semantics) and keep it consistent with the `-D` switch. Depends on US-001 (same file, sequential edits). FAKES-LIE HAZARD (auditor F-02): the -d -> -D switch BREAKS the pre-existing assertion at test/release/post-merge.test.ts:188 (test branch deleted locally and remotely), whose localDelete finder asserts c.args.includes(-d) (line ~193): change it to -D. Also extend the same happySpawn/makeSpawnFn fakes (lines 32-80) to model git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/<mergedBranch> (present AND absent cases) and git branch -D, since they currently return the status-0 empty-stdout default. US-002 keeps its OWN bun test/check:all green by owning these edits here, not deferring to US-004.

userStories.title: Coalesce post-merge narration + prune sub-status into one notifyOrchestrator line
userStories.description: As the merge-watch state machine, I need the post-merge-complete narration and its prune sub-status to be a single notifyOrchestrator line, so that the back-to-back send-keys race (which swallows the second line in the orchestrator's re-rendering Ink prompt) cannot occur on the MERGED-success path.
acceptanceCriteria: On the post-merge success path (result.ok), notifyOrchestrator is called EXACTLY ONCE for the completion line. [oracle: bun test]

warnOnPruneFailure no longer calls notifyOrchestrator; it is refactored into a pure builder returning a string/status that is folded into the single completion line. [oracle: sed -n '/function warnOnPruneFailure/,/^}/p' src/release/merge-watch.ts > /tmp/_wopf.txt && ! grep -q 'notifyOrchestrator' /tmp/_wopf.txt]

When a prune leg genuinely failed (branchPrunedLocal or branchPrunedRemote false), the single completion line carries the prune sub-status (e.g. mentions 'prune' with local/remote status); when both pruned, the line carries no prune-failure sub-status. [oracle: bun test]
No second notifyOrchestrator call is reintroduced anywhere on the MERGED-success branch of processPollResult (sendkeys-literal-enter-gotcha). [oracle: bun test]
The logEvent('merge-watch-post-merge-done', ...) detail still carries branchPrunedLocal/branchPrunedRemote reflecting the real end-state (unchanged). [oracle: bun test]

A bullet is appended to scripts/cam/patterns.md documenting the invariant: notifyOrchestrator must not send two lines with no work between them; coalesce instead. [oracle: grep -qi 'coalesce' scripts/cam/patterns.md]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Aggregate quality gate passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/merge-watch.ts (warnOnPruneFailure lines 296-306; processPollResult MERGED branch 323-345; double narration is lines 330-331) and scripts/cam/patterns.md. Refactor warnOnPruneFailure(prunedLocal, prunedRemote) to RETURN a string suffix (empty when both ok) instead of calling notifyOrchestrator; concatenate it into the line 330 `[cam] post-merge complete: <tag> <tagNote>` narration so there is one send-keys. GOTCHA from spec: do NOT reintroduce a second notifyOrchestrator on the MERGED-success path; the orchestrator Ink prompt does not absorb back-to-back send-keys (see patterns.md 'Single-pusher invariant' and 'notifyOrchestrator placement rule' bullets, plus memory sendkeys-literal-enter-gotcha). The post-merge-FAILED path (line 339) is a single narration already; leave it. notifyOrchestrator is the same seam from makeNotifyOrchestrator (src/supervisor/host.ts:193-204) -- do not invent a new channel. acceptanceCriteria: A test asserts remote already-absent (empty `git ls-remote`) => branchPrunedRemote:true and no prune-failure narration. [oracle: bun test]
A test asserts remote present + delete fails AND branch still present => branchPrunedRemote:false. [oracle: bun test]
A test asserts local branch already absent (rev-parse empty) => branchPrunedLocal:true. [oracle: bun test]
A test asserts local branch present => `git branch -D` is invoked (recorded in the SpawnFn call list). [oracle: bun test]
A test asserts a post-merge-with-prune-incomplete run produces EXACTLY ONE notifyOrchestrator call whose single line contains the tag AND the prune sub-status. [oracle: bun test]

The pre-existing merge-watch test that asserted a SEPARATE warn line on prune failure (test/release/merge-watch.test.ts ~line 833) is updated to the coalesced-single-line contract so the suite stays green. [oracle: bun test]
